test_title: PYST 55: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 22 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
​​​Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which is the letter-cluster pair that DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f4e7d7b71681393ac2460271b3e1a42360f1458914ac92b44b7f6c62638ea25c.png] 

**Logic followed here is**: In each pair, the letters of the second cluster are obtained by adding 5 to the positional values of the corresponding letters in the first cluster.

Option 1: EK - JP

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c1e8c939c6f3d911e79997c060b2eec24cc8222812b76134485ed44e2b114afb.png] 

Option 2: KQ - PV

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/517079eedd3f7d3e4929d7e9621fab466a1ef837ef233deeb3f4ca302893ba69.png] 

Option 3: NT - SY

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c3d66264e74589ed12c7025b70cf6dc919f6dd57ad8f6b666981ddc2308b272e.png] 

**Option 4: OU - TA**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3b2ce117a9c52a3e08bbd5be3d6f3deb9f4155b474104ce4f9d0792077b976c5.png] 

Therefore, the letter-cluster pair that DOES NOT belong to that group is **OU - TA**.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**
